The '''Rothana Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that started around the junction of the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] and the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]], and led to the planet of [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]], controlled by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] as of around [[800 BBY/Legends|800 BBY]].

The route acted as a lane between the outer [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and Rothana, as the location of the planet was secret, and the only way KDY ships could get there was to download encrypted coordinates and a friend-or-foe signal from [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|jump beacons]] beyond [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]]. Before [[Hyperspace/Legends|jumping]], the ship would have to transmit the signal to temporaly deactivate the [[Gravity mine/Legends|gravity mines]] along the route. In [[311 BBY]], the [[Kuati Succession Crisis]] was sparked after the [[Ursela Kuat's star yacht|yacht]] carrying the KDY leader [[Ursela Kuat]] was destroyed along the Rothana Route.
